subject: Math
prompt: For a project on combustion, Marcus recorded the height of a candle as it burned over time. The function $P(t) = 45 - 0.18t$ gives the estimated height, in millimeters (mm), of the candle $t$ hours after it was lit. Which of the following is the best interpretation of $45$ in this context?

choices.A: The estimated change in the height, in mm, of the candle each hour
choices.B: The estimated height, in mm, of the candle when it was lit
choices.C: The estimated height, in mm, of the candle when it finished burning
choices.D: The estimated number of hours it took for the candle to burn completely

explanation: Choice B is correct. It's given that $P(t) = 45 - 0.18t$ gives the estimated height, in millimeters (mm), of the candle $t$ hours after it was lit. For a linear function in the form $P(t) = a + bt$, where $a$ and $b$ are constants, $a$ represents the value of $P(0)$. The given function can be written as $P(t) = -0.18t + 45$. It follows that $45$ represents the value of $P(0)$, or the estimated height of the candle when $t = 0$. Therefore, the best interpretation of $45$ is the estimated height, in mm, of the candle when it was lit.
